yep201.title: Yamaha: YEP-201 Student Euphonium
yep201.scope: YEP-201 is explicitly positioned as a lighter student euphonium for younger players with easy response. Manufacturer claim, not universal teacher recommendation.

besson162.title: Besson: Prodige 162 Student Euphonium
besson162.scope: Student euphonium with 3+1 layout; used only as an alternative learning route in the quality-led comparison.

fender_cd60s.title: Fender: CD-60S / beginner acoustic context
fender_cd60s.scope: Fender describes CD-60S as a beginner/aspiring-player dreadnought. This does not make dreadnought the correct body size for every beginner.

fender_cc60s.title: Fender: CC-60S Concert
fender_cc60s.scope: Compact concert body explicitly described as ideal for beginning players; body-size suitability still requires fitting.

distinctions: Low weight and 3+1 valve training are separate euphonium learning goals.
Dreadnought and concert-body are peer body-shape routes, not quality ranks.
Body size and scale length remain independent acoustic-guitar fitting coordinates.
Public pages do not assert ONTOS.RENT stock.
